heading.purpose: Hero headline, section titles, card titles. Geometric, slightly technical.

body.purpose: Narrative copy: descriptions, testimonial quotes, supporting text.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, stat labels, timestamps, nav-adjacent metadata, footer group headers. Always uppercase, wide-tracked — the system's 'live data' signal.

shadows.name: overlay-lg
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system — mobile navigation drawer/sheet overlay. Never used on content surfaces (see The Flat-By-Default Rule).

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Sponsor logo ticker — infinite horizontal scroll of duplicated content, edge-masked, pauses on hover via motion-safe:group-hover:paused.

motion.name: live-ping
motion.purpose: Translucent twin behind the solid Live Indicator dot — the recurring 'this is real-time' signal in the hero badge and stats-bar header.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default Tailwind transition-all easing used for button/link hover and color transitions.

motion.name: ease-power-on
motion.purpose: The system's one entrance-motion easing (Power-On Reveal): opacity + translate-y-3 + blur-[6px] to settled, 500ms, IntersectionObserver-triggered once (or on-mount for the Hero's rehearsed sequence). Content is visible by default so scripting-disabled/reduced-motion visitors never see a stuck-hidden state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default button — Signal Teal fill, white text. The system's baseline action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #04a18f; color: #ffffff; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(4,161,143,0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(20,184,166,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Ember Amber fill for the single highest-priority action per section (e.g. 'Join Community').
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: #f2a93b; color: #241505; height: 44px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: rgba(242,169,59,0.85); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action — Hairline border, transparent fill, fills with Fog on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #0f1b19; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #dceae7; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #eff4f3; }

components.name: Data Tag Badge
components.description: Compact metadata tag (e.g. event type) — squared corners distinguish it from a full-pill status badge.
components.css: .ds-badge-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #5b6c69; border: 1px solid #dceae7; border-radius: 5px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Standard event/content card — hairline border, no shadow, compact internal padding around a media placeholder.

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dceae7; border-radius: 11px; padding: 12px; } .ds-card-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #eaf5f3, #eaf5f3, #eff4f3); } .ds-card-title { margin-top: 10px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #0f1b19; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-meta { margin-top: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #5b6c69; }

components.name: Live Indicator
components.description: Two-layer pulsing dot + mono uppercase label. The system's recurring 'this is real-time' signal.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5b6c69; } .ds-live-dot-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 6px; height: 6px; } .ds-live-ping { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(4,161,143,0.7); animation: ds-ping 1.5s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite; } .ds-live-dot { position: relative; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #04a18f; } @keyframes ds-ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2.5); opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Sponsor Marquee
components.description: Infinite edge-masked horizontal scroll of sponsor names, pauses on hover.
components.html: Sponsor OneSponsor TwoSponsor Three
components.css: .ds-marquee-wrap { overflow: hidden; border-top: 1px solid #dceae7; border-bottom: 1px solid #dceae7; padding: 20px 0; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 10%, black 90%, transparent); mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 10%, black 90%, transparent); } .ds-marquee-track { display: flex; width: max-content; animation: ds-marquee 34s linear infinite; } .ds-marquee-wrap:hover .ds-marquee-track { animation-play-state: paused; } .ds-marquee-item { padding: 0 32px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; color: #5b6c69; } @keyframes ds-marquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

narrative.overview:
PPBD's website reads like the front console of a community that is actually running: mono-uppercase labels, a pulsing live-status dot next to tabular stats, a faint dot-grid texture behind the hero, and a marquee ticker of sponsor names — all signals borrowed from operational instrumentation rather than brochure marketing. The mood is precise and operational: confident, data-forward, engineering-flavored. Warmth is deliberately narrow — it comes only from Ember Amber accents and softened corners, never from decorative styling, gradients-as-decoration, or soft illustration.

The system is flat by construction. There are no drop shadows on any content surface — depth is built entirely from hairline borders, tonal card fills, and occasional blurred glow orbs anchoring hero/CTA sections. This is a deliberate invariant, not an unfinished state.

Two structural sections — the final Join Community CTA and the site footer — are hardcoded to a fixed deep-teal-ink surface regardless of light/dark theme. They act as dark anchors bracketing the page, always-dark on purpose.
keyCharacteristics: Mono-uppercase eyebrow labels and tabular-numeric stats, used the way a terminal readout is used.
A live pulse-dot (ping animation + solid dot) as the recurring 'this is real and current' signal.
Flat surfaces: hairline borders + tonal fills, zero drop shadows on content.
Two fixed dark-teal-ink sections (CTA, footer) that don't follow the light/dark theme toggle.
Signal Teal as the sole primary action/brand color; Ember Amber reserved for the one emphasized action per section.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ember Amber appears at most once per section — one CTA button, one rating row, one underline bar. If teal is already carrying the primary action, amber does not also appear as decoration in the same viewport.

rules.name: The Dark Anchor Rule
rules.body: The final CTA and the footer are always rendered in the fixed Ink surface, independent of the light/dark theme toggle. They are structural bookends, not theme-reactive content.

rules.name: The Mono-Metadata Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a label, timestamp, count, or status — never narrative prose — is set in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, wide-tracked. This is the system's primary way of signaling 'this is live/factual data,' independent of color.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons, and content blocks never use box-shadow. If a surface needs to feel 'raised,' reach for a border and a tonal background shift first. Reserve shadow for transient overlays (drawers, popovers, dropdowns).

rules.name: The One Entrance Rule
rules.body: Every scroll/mount reveal on the site uses the Power-On Reveal (opacity + rise + blur, ease-power-on). Don't introduce a second fade/slide/zoom entrance pattern — vary only how it's composed (single block, staggered list, or the CTA's accent-bar draw-in), never the underlying motion material.

dos: Do set every label, stat, timestamp, and eyebrow in mono, uppercase, wide-tracked — this is the system's primary 'live data' signal.
Do build depth with borders and tonal fills, never box-shadow, on any content surface.
Do keep Ember Amber to one use per section; let Signal Teal carry everything else.
Do reuse the Live Indicator dot pattern for anything claiming to be current/real-time — don't invent a second version.
Do keep the CTA and footer sections on the fixed dark Ink surface regardless of theme.
Do reuse the Power-On Reveal for any new entrance motion — don't invent a second fade/slide pattern.
donts: Don't add drop shadows to cards, buttons, or content blocks — reserve shadow-lg for overlays (drawers, popovers, sheets) only.
Don't use Ember Amber as a large background fill or apply it more than once per section.
Don't let narrative body copy slip into mono/uppercase — that treatment is reserved for labels/metadata only.
Don't ship a hard-edged, unmasked grid or texture pattern — the dot-grid always fades via mask, never sits at full, even opacity across a section.
